title: Output of `omarchy plugin list --json` (Omarchy 4.0.4, observed)
description: Third-party input format, not part of the engine/plugin contract. Produced by the shell IPC call listPlugins (shell.qml). There is no version field. `enabled` means 'in the bar' for bar widgets.

active.description: only true for the active bar

clonedFrom.description: source id of a clone (omarchy plugin clone), else empty
